name: weather
description: Current weather + 3-day forecast for any location. Free via wttr.in (no key, no auth). Use when the user asks about weather, temperature, rain, etc. for a place.

location.description: City name, airport code, postcode, or 'lat,lon' coordinates. Examples: 'Karachi', 'JFK', '94103', '33.6844,73.0479'.
